newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - AlliedSignal said started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - AlliedSignal said started.

text.p: -- PaineWebber started coverage of AlliedSignal Inc with an attractive rating, a PaineWebber source said.
-- PaineWebber analyst Jack Modzelewski confirmed he started coverage of AlliedSignal, calling it "one of the best managed companies in the world."

-- He noted AlliedSignal "has been doing extremely well and gotten a lot of recognition. The question is: Can (chief executive) Larry Bossidy take it to the next level of performance? I'm not willing to bet he won't."
-- "Reputation and performance-wise he has clearly demonstrated he's in the top percentiles to run companies," Modzelewski said.
-- He set a "low 80's" 12-month price target and share earnings estimates of $3.60 for the current fiscal year ended December and $4.20 for the next fiscal year.
